sentences.en: A bat flying in the sky looks like a butterfly.
sentences.zh: 一只蝙蝠在天空中飞翔看起来像是一只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: There is an advertising balloon flying above the department store.
sentences.zh: 百货商店上方有一个飘动的广告气球。

sentences.en: I saw a lot of birds flying toward the south.
sentences.zh: 我看到很多鸟儿向南方飞去。
